fields.help: Item field holding the local image path. Defaults to image_path, path, file_path, or media_path (first non-empty).
fields.label: Image Path Field

fields.help: Brightness adjustment (-100 to 100). 0 leaves it unchanged.
fields.label: Brightness

fields.help: Contrast adjustment (-100 to 100). 0 leaves it unchanged.
fields.label: Contrast

fields.help: Saturation adjustment (-100 to 100). 0 leaves it unchanged.
fields.label: Saturation

fields.help: Gamma correction. >1 brightens, <1 darkens, 1.0 leaves it unchanged.
fields.label: Gamma

fields.help: Sharpening radius in pixels. 0 disables sharpening.
fields.label: Sharpen (sigma px)

fields.help: Gaussian blur sigma in pixels. 0 disables blur.
fields.label: Blur (sigma px)

fields.help: Item field where the output file path is written.
fields.label: Output Field

fields.help: Directory for the adjusted file. Defaults to the source image's directory. ~ is expanded.
fields.label: Output Directory
